full_details: The morning rehearsal kept yesterday's note and did not raise it. At the Bell, Hobbins wrote every item and read the list back before he would cord the pack. The quarter's sixty shillings went in canvas. With it went the raisins and a paper of sugar, the prunes and a ballad of the Queen's day, Anne's grey kerchief with no verse, six Seville oranges, a sugar-loaf, cinnamon, holland for Joan, the russet Mistress Ansell chose, a book of fables with no riddles, a ballad-sheet whose tune is named at the head, a leather ball stitched hard, and a groat for each child. He had Anne's letter. Susanna has found two faults. Judith has told the street. Hamnet would know about the sword. The porch is given up for the winter. Last, the pane, and the house getting cheaper. You read that sentence in the yard, laughed with your shoulders, and read it again. You did not add a line to Sunday's letter. Nobody shouted down the yard. The Rose had the first part of Hercules on a board. You did not go. At two you played, and the strip did not name the part. You did not count the coffer.
one_sentence: Hobbins read the pack back and corded it, you laughed at the cheaper pane, and in the afternoon you played.
title: The pack read back, then corded
